title: SupplierQualification
description: The durable qualification status of a supplier, distinct from the OnboardingCase that produced it. Persists across events and re-validations. This is the object that, in a federated marketplace, a supplier could own and present across buyers; build it separate from the Case so portability is an extension, not a rebuild.

qualifiedBy.description: The party holding the qualification (the buyer today; potentially supplier-held in federation).

valueCap.description: Maximum value the supplier is qualified for, when conditionType is valueCap.

restrictedTo.description: Categories the supplier is limited to, when categoryRestriction.

dueDate.description: When a pendingCheck must be resolved by.

conditions.description: Limits attached when status is conditional.

classifications.description: Categories the supplier is qualified for (e.g. CPV).

credentials.description: The durable verified facts. Screening results (sanctions/AML) appear here as result credentials with provenance — SIGNET carries the attestation; it does not perform the determination.

validity.description: The qualification validity window; expiry triggers a revalidation case.

lastDecision.description: The Decision that set the current status.

originatingCase.description: The OnboardingCase that first produced this qualification.
